method.nvs: NVS = 100*(1-exp(-max(z*S,0)/3)); z = weighted mean of per-source z-scores (last complete day vs prior 30 days, floored sigma); S = 1 + 0.5*sentiment (GDELT tone/5, clamped to [-1,1]).
method.smii: 0.4*VC cluster + 0.4*options call skew + 0.2*13F net change, renormalised over available components; coverage reported.
method.capital: 0.6*tape score (+ DeFi flows for crypto) + 0.4*SMII; VC trends use SMII only. Tape = relative strength, dollar-volume ratio, Chaikin money flow.
